# Business Owner

> Knowledge and advisory platform for business owners, entrepreneurs and decision-makers.

Business Owner publishes practical frameworks about business strategy, business engineering, growth, marketing, distribution, ecommerce, SEO and AI visibility.

## Core areas
- Business strategy and business models
- Business engineering and operating systems
- Growth strategy and customer acquisition
- Marketing consulting
- SEO, AEO, GEO and AI visibility
- Commercial agency and distribution
- Digital transformation

- /articles

- /contact
